# Design point P001

## Description

Repositories are explicitly registered to activate local configuration and background performance maintenance, while any absent copy is reconstructed on demand from durable log state. Reconstructed repositories use delta-compressed packfile storage, reducing storage requirements but potentially adding read hops.
